name: documint
description: DocuMint code documentation: HTML, Markdown or both, with original viewer identity and ready-artifact validation; no MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Say Use DocuMint and select HTML, Markdown or Both. HTML is a finished downloadable artifact from the original DocuMint Local viewer, validated offline against its pinned renderer SHA; generator-only ZIPs do not satisfy the request. Legacy project-data ZIPs can be repaired. Source analysis is AI-assisted unless the original deterministic analyzer ran. Requires host file-writing capability; no MCP server or Google Drive.
defaultPrompt: Use DocuMint to generate HTML documentation for these files.
Use DocuMint to generate both HTML and Markdown.

publication.release_notes: v0.3.2 adds strict direct HTML delivery, original renderer integrity pin, offline legacy ZIP recovery, ready-artifact ZIP validation and end-to-end tests.
